admissions.reason: Pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis is a specific type of infectious tenosynovitis with distinct anatomical involvement.
Infectious tenosynovitis is a broader category that includes pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis. R2 is more specific and better supported by the focal findings.
Septic arthritis involves joints, which is distinct from the flexor sheath involvement seen in tenosynovitis or the skin involvement of cellulitis.
Cellulitis is an infection of the skin and subcutaneous tissue, distinct from the deeper flexor sheath infection or joint infection.
